privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your trust matters to us. This policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how we keep it safe.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect details you provide when placing an order or subscribing — such as your name, contact number, delivery address and email. We also collect limited technical data (like device and browsing information) to improve your experience.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: Your information is used to process and deliver orders, respond to enquiries, send order updates, and — only with your consent — share occasional offers and new collection announcements.

sections.heading: Sharing & Disclosure
sections.body: We never sell your personal data. We share information only with trusted delivery and payment partners strictly to fulfil your order, and where required by law.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to remember your cart, preferences and improve site performance. You may disable cookies in your browser, though some features may not work as intended.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We apply industry-standard safeguards to protect your data. Payments are processed through secure, encrypted gateways and we never store full card details.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by writing to hello@gharelu.bake.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By placing an order with Gharelu.Bake, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Orders & Availability
sections.body: All orders are subject to availability. We reserve the right to decline or cancel an order in rare cases such as ingredient shortages or delivery constraints, with a full refund where applicable.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: Prices are listed in INR and are inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. We may update prices from time to time without prior notice.

sections.heading: Custom Orders
sections.body: Custom and celebration cakes require advance notice of 48–72 hours. Final designs are crafted at our artisans' discretion while honouring your brief as closely as possible.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Delivery timelines are estimates and may vary due to traffic, weather or unforeseen circumstances. Please ensure someone is available to receive perishable items.

sections.heading: Product Nature
sections.body: As every item is handmade in small batches, slight variations in colour, finish and decoration are natural and part of the artisan charm.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content, imagery, recipes and branding on this website belong to Gharelu.Bake and may not be reproduced without written permission.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.intro: As a fresh, made-to-order bakery, our refund policy balances fairness with the perishable nature of our products.

sections.heading: Cancellations
sections.body: Orders may be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the scheduled delivery or pickup time. Cancellations within 24 hours are non-refundable as preparation will have begun.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Eligible refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5–7 business days. Custom and celebration cakes are non-refundable once production has started.

sections.heading: Damaged or Incorrect Orders
sections.body: If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, please contact us within 4 hours of delivery with photographs. We will arrange a replacement or refund at our discretion.

sections.heading: Quality Concerns
sections.body: Your satisfaction is our priority. If something isn't right, reach out to hello@gharelu.bake and our team will make it right.

sections.heading: Non-Refundable Items
sections.body: Perishable items that have been accepted in good condition, and personalised or bespoke orders, are not eligible for refund.
